The test that decides, and what waiting costs
Can every stored before/after be re-expressed as an event over a node id, without guessing at a quote and
without losing which passage was cited? If yes, take Option 1. If no, Option 2 is the honest choice and the graph
stays a view. Deciding now costs one migration; deciding later costs either the audit trail or the graph, because
both are already written in the other key.
Read from app/store.py (claim_versions, history) and policy_dependency_graph.py (node ids) on 2026-10-31.
